name: NL Scholarship
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the participating Dutch institutions (Study in NL / Nuffic)

summary.fr: Bourse nationale néerlandaise (ex-Holland Scholarship) : 5 000 EUR versés la première année d'études, en licence.
summary.en: Dutch national scholarship (formerly the Holland Scholarship): EUR 5,000 paid in the first year of Bachelor studies.

howToApply.fr: Vérifiez les critères sur le site de l'établissement participant que vous visez.
howToApply.en: Check the criteria on the website of the participating institution you choose.

eligibility.quote: The NL Scholarship (formerly known as Holland Scholarship) is meant for international students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA)

level.quote: You are applying for a full-time bachelor’s or master’s programme at one of the participating Dutch higher education institutions.

support.quote: The scholarship amounts to € 5,000. You will receive this in the first year of your studies.

howToApply.quote: Please check the website of the institution you want to apply to for the specific deadline(s).
